title: I (mostly Claude) made a daily puzzle game for stock charts.
author: Casbo1
selftext: I (but mostly Claude) built readthetape.cc. It's wordle for day trading chart readers. Everyone gets the same five blind stock charts each day. The charts are real S&P 500 historical data with the prices rescaled so they cannot be recognised. You predict the next five days and place a paper money bet. The backend uses FastAPI to serve the historical data based on a daily seed. It is free, plays in the browser, and requires no signup. Check it out, please lmk feedback
